entries.title: Progressive transaction detail disclosure with pre-submission preview
entries.summary: GET /reconcile/stellar/tx/{txid} and POST /reconcile/stellar/transactions accept details=summary|standard|advanced and dryRun=true. Responses add a disclosure block with per-section collapsed/expanded state; omitting details keeps the previous response shape byte for byte.

protocolSurfaces.description: Optional ?details=summary|standard|advanced query parameter returning the tiered disclosure block.
Optional ?details= and ?dryRun= query parameters; dryRun projects the transaction without writing it.
Optional ?details= and ?dryRun= query parameters on the existing list endpoint.

migration.notes: No migration. Callers that do not send ?details= receive the unchanged legacy payload, so the change is additive.

entries.title: Dependency health endpoints and operator diagnostics command
entries.summary: Adds GET /health/dependencies for a credential-free local summary, GET /health/dependencies/diagnostics for authenticated maintainers, and the npm run deps:health command that prints the same report to a terminal.

protocolSurfaces.description: Public local-only summary of dependency states; returns 503 when a critical dependency is unavailable.
Admin-only report including sanitized network probe results and remediation hints.
Maintainer-readable dependency report with --json, --no-network and --only flags.

migration.notes: No migration. New environment variables are optional and default to the previous behaviour.

entries.title: Machine-readable protocol changelog
entries.summary: Adds GET /changelog/protocol backed by changelog/protocol-changes.json, validated against changelog/schema/protocol-changes.schema.json in CI and by npm run changelog:validate.

protocolSurfaces.description: Protocol-facing changes with impact, migration and version filters.
Validates the changelog against the schema and the semantic rules; exits non-zero on any violation.
Optional override for the changelog file location, used by the validator and the API.

migration.notes: No migration. Consumers that need upgrade warnings can poll the endpoint from the version they run.

entries.title: Fault injection suite for network, wallet and persistence failures
entries.summary: Adds a deterministic fault injection harness and npm run test:faults, covering timeouts, malformed provider responses, partial writes and retry behaviour including the absence of duplicate irreversible side effects.

protocolSurfaces.description: Runs the fault injection specs with no outbound network access.
Exercises partial-write and constraint-violation paths that leave no duplicate rows behind.

migration.notes: No migration. Test-only harness; nothing is added to the production bundle.
